haar_averaging.scope: Finite averaging and singular interval examples, not nilpotent boundary maps.

backward_recurrence.scope: Finite cyclic group recurrence, including all intermediate state constraints.

normalized_counts.scope: Deterministic count normalization, not the source random-star concentration estimates.

cone_conditional_tests.scope: Non-Hilbert tripod cone identities plus generic TV bounds; no source conditional star coupling verified.

small_complete_sets.scope: Finite marking formula and class-count identity; infinite-class dominated convergence is analytic, not a finite test.

marker_graphings.scope: Finite commuting-action and height propagation models; no measured cost lower bound.

split_boundary.scope: Checks split-chain algebra. The Hurewicz realization of attaching spheres is not implemented.

fox_character.scope: Exact local-system boundary and injectivity; the tower obstruction excluding a 2-dimensional model is not certified.

limitations: Selected mechanisms only; no global recognition, non-CAT action, non-fixed-price or D(2) conclusion certified; no Lean build.
